description: This file defines the IBasketQueryService interface, which provides a method to asynchronously fetch the count of total basket items for a given user without running in memory.

classes.name: IBasketQueryService
classes.description: Interface for querying basket data, specifically for counting total items in a user's basket.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the total number of basket items for the specified user.
